rules: Preserve all requirements; do not mark a feature passed without matching runtime or artifact evidence.
Never modify the previous checkout, production data or Bot workspaces during development.
Never permanently delete files or fixtures; move obsolete owned material to Trash.
Use synthetic data in tracked source and tests.
Keep private deployment and migration evidence in ignored local directories.
Prefer supported OpenClaw interfaces over private runtime modules.
Commit reviewed source changes locally; external publication follows the user's authorized scope.
